title: Split the pot into side pots for unequal all-ins
description:
As a learner, I want side pots created when players are all-in for different amounts, so that each player can win only the chips they matched.

Each pot records the set of eligible players and is awarded only among them (best hand, ties split per REQ-019.3). Total chips at the table are identical before and after every hand.

## Requirements covered
- REQ-018 (Must): All-in and side pots — When a player cannot match a bet, the engine shall let that player call all-in for the chips they have and shall create side pots so that each player can win only the amounts they matched.
- REQ-019 (Must): Showdown and pot award — At showdown, the engine shall rank each eligible player's highest-ranking five-card hand from their two hole cards and the five board cards, award each pot to its highest-ranked eligible hand, and split tied pots equally.

Covers: REQ-018, REQ-019

Plan key: E01-S13 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given three players all-in for $10, $30 and $50 with a fourth covering, When pots are built, Then a main pot and two side pots exist, each recording exactly the players who matched it as eligible [REQ-018.2]
Given a folded player contributed to a pot, When pots are built, Then that player is not eligible for any pot [REQ-018.2]

Given the shortest all-in player holds the best hand in a three-way all-in, When pots are awarded, Then that player wins only the main pot and the side pot goes to the best hand among its eligible players [REQ-018.3]
Given a four-way all-in at four different stack sizes with scripted cards, When pots are awarded, Then each pot's winner equals the expected winner from the scripted hand ranks [REQ-018.3]
Given 100,000 random seeded hands with random stacks, When each hand ends, Then the total chips at the table equal the total before the hand [REQ-018.5]

Given a sit-and-go hand where seat 3 wins the main pot and a 1,255-chip side pot is tied by seats 2 and 5 with the button at seat 1, When pots are awarded, Then seat 2 receives 628 chips and seat 5 receives 627 chips from the side pot [REQ-019.3, REQ-018.3]

Given a $29 pot tied three ways by seats 3, 5 and 6 with the button at seat 4, When the pot is awarded, Then the two odd dollars go one each clockwise from left of the button: seat 5 receives $10, seat 6 receives $10 and seat 3 receives $9 [REQ-019.9]
Given side pots, When the invariant checker runs, Then each eligible seat has contributed at least that pot's level and each pot's amount equals its contribution layer
Given side pots exist, When tests/engine/review-gaps.acceptance.test.ts runs, Then the folded-contributor test (SPEC-02) still passes for every pot
